sources.researchNote: The BnF records Charlie Davson as the pseudonym of Charles Secchia, a French male lyricist, with responsibilities as author and performer. It gives his dates as “Naissance : 18..?” and “Mort : 19..”, indicating a nineteenth-century birth and a twentieth-century death, with neither year established. The notice cites the printed music “Je ne connais personne”, words by Ch. Davson with German words by Emmerich Lazar and P. Doenen, music by Emeric Lazar, 1938, and gives ISNI 0000 0003 5830 9767. Fifty-six BnF bibliographic records are linked to him as author.
